senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. m. Uzziah, king of Judah.
units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 7b:7">M. Kat. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>יותם לא היה לו לע׳ וכ׳</he> Jotham was begotten by U. after the latter was declared a leper; <cite ref="Tosefta Negaim 8:6">Tosef. Neg. VIII, 6</cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 20">Gen. R. s. 20</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 35">Yalk. ib. 35</cite>.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4:20">Num. R. s. 4</cite> <he>שעל ידו נצטרע ע׳</he> on account of it (the offering of frankincense) U. became a leper.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 7:5">Num. R. s. 7</cite> <he>זה ע׳ שבקש להכנס בתחום וכ׳</he> that is U. who attempted to encroach on the domain of priesthood; a. e.
